name: B10-0473/2025 (PPE) – Renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position ahead of a summit between European and African Union leaders in Angola. It calls for a true partnership of equals, not aid. It wants more trade and investment, especially through the Global Gateway fund, support for African peace efforts, and action on migration, climate and youth. It also urges EU countries to finish ratifying the Samoa Agreement, the current framework for EU relations with African, Caribbean and Pacific states.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament gives its opinion and asks EU leaders to act at the summit.
- **Who it affects:** African and European governments, businesses, students, researchers and migrants.
- **What happens next:** EU and African Union leaders meet in Luanda to agree joint priorities for 2025–2030.
